text.en: Shikha and Sonu measure saris and stoles at the village weaving centre. Some lengths are in centimetres and some in metres. Which are the same length?

We measure short lengths in centimetres and longer lengths in metres. 1 metre is 100 centimetres.
A double number line helps: 1 m is above 100 cm, 2 m above 200 cm, and so on, each step times 100. So 5 m 40 cm is 540 cm, and 2 m 4 cm is 204 cm.
For very long distances we use the kilometre. 1,000 metres make 1 kilometre. Kilo means thousand.
Choose the right unit: the height of India Gate in metres, the length of a handkerchief in centimetres, a mobile phone in centimetres.
Rope idea: to make 1 km you need ten ropes of 100 m, or two of 500 m, or four of 250 m.
A 3 km race needs water stations every 500 m, so you set them at 500 m, 1,000 m, 1,500 m, 2,000 m and 2,500 m.
